bio: GregPorn is a CWI roster artist in the cyberpunk rap / conscious alt lane. His single "Pay Yourself" — a mental-health-awareness anthem produced by Rick Friedrich of The Roots camp and co-produced by Black Lansky — is documented in Cumulative Web Inc's published material (Nov 2025), alongside "On Edge" (psychological-thriller sync asset) and "Unholy Hunter" (dystopian gaming trailer hook) in CWI's cyberpunk-rap buyer's guide. Cloud 9 (59,290 plays, with Gillie da Kid and Freeway features) is held back until Black confirms it is the same Greg Porn — identity unconfirmed. Owner-verified 2026-10-02 — Black Lansky confirmed the artist and his co-production credits on Pay Yourself and On Edge. Streaming profile links to be added.
